kitDescription: Eunhwa: Tactical Upgrade is a Fire SR Attacker whose burst swaps her rifle for a single-round true-damage cannon (0.3s charge, 300% full-charge multiplier) that she fires and reloads repeatedly for the swap window. Each cannon shot that lands puts a 27.87% Damage Taken debuff on the boss for 10 seconds, refreshing with every hit, so the whole team hits harder while she cycles the cannon. Her Skill 1 grants Camouflage on burst use and on full charges during Full Burst; while Camouflaged her normal attacks become true damage and she gains a 42.24% True Damage buff (in the sim the buff is windowed to the Camouflage uptime and pays off on her true-flavored cannon shots; the base-rifle flavor change is unmodeled). Her Skill 2 is a passive formation: 8.16% Crit Rate to her squad (modeled as the whole deployed team), 41.81% Charge Damage to all allies, and 42.24% ATK to herself. If Emma: Tactical Upgrade is also fielded, two bonus buffs activate for all allies: 5.11% Projectile Explosion Damage and 30.97% True Damage.

redAssertions: (a) 'is load-bearing: zeroing the magnitude strictly lowers HER damage' — blind-fixture artifact: controlComp seats crown at B2 ahead of SLUG, so SLUG never casts her burst in that fixture and her only damage is non-true base SR normals on which trueDamagePct is correctly inert; the driver's sole-B2 fixture shows the 0.4224 dmgUp drop per cannon shot. Not an encoding error.

(b) 'Critical Rate 8.16% is SQUAD-scoped' — convention divergence: blind reads same-squad as self-only in a squad-less comp; driver encodes allies per the documented project convention (one deployed squad ⇒ same-squad ≡ team; anchor-innocent-maid / emma-tu precedent). Ruled FAITHFUL-by-convention; flagged for owner spot-check.

(c) 'the Explosive Round debuff actually lands on the boss' — blind-reader bug: the blind applies() helper filters casterIdx === SLUG slot, but boss debuffs carry casterIdx === null && targetIdx === null (the exact trap S2b named). Driver evidence: apps count === cannon-shot count, mult.taken 1.2787 across >90% of damage instances. Not an encoding error.

verdictRationale: GO. Convergence is RED on paper (13/3/5) but all three red assertions resolve against the blind side: (a) is a controlComp fixture artifact (crown shadows SLUG at B2 so she never bursts — the driver's sole-B2 fixture shows the 0.4224-per-cannon-shot payoff), (c) is the exact casterIdx===null boss-debuff reader bug S2b pre-named, and (b) is a convention divergence the driver documented with repo precedent (same-squad ≡ the single deployed squad). The genuinely divergent blind claims are all refuted by the prose: S6 fell into S2b's #1 named nearest-wrong (permanent Camouflage passive) and shipped the LT bonus ungated (S2b's highest-stakes over-credit), while the driver encoded the windowed co-extensive construction and the teamHas.slugs gate S2b demanded; S6's cast-triggered debuff is also weaker than the driver's on-hit refresh. Every kit line is FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP (score 1.0); every FAITHFUL block provably fires at prose cadence (cannon shots ≥2/full window, debuff apps === shot count, in-FB refreshes > FB count); discrimination holds via exact-arithmetic counterfactuals (3.4181 vs 4.2543 charge, 1.4224/1.7321 dmgUp floors, maxShots:1 shot-count, wrong-stat debuff). The three gotchas are all documented by the driver and none is silent: the squad-scope convention (low), the unmodeled true-flavor normals (med, under-count with ⚑ + recipe), and the kit-silent swap duration (med, ⚑ measurement-gated by all three agents). Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the same-squad ≡ whole-team convention — two independent blind reads both took 'from the same squad' as a real filter (self-only here), so if squad data ever lands, re-scope; secondary: the 'emma-tu presence ≡ LT Formation applied' assumption behind the auto-gate (and its asymmetry with emma-tu's manual mirror mode), which the driver reported correctly without expanding scope.
